routeData.headline: Every hour we test a stablecoin against apps on {route}
routeData.lead: Cost is what the recipient loses against the mid-market rate, the middle price banks trade at with each other. A stablecoin is a coin that stays worth one US dollar.
routeData.bigCaption: Hours in which a stablecoin was cheapest at any amount, out of {priced} priced
routeData.loadFailed: The route prices did not load. Reload to try again.
routeData.chartAria: Hourly cost of the cheapest stablecoin path against the cheapest app
routeData.chartCaptionAbs: In {ccy}, as a loss against the mid-market rate.
routeData.chartCaptionRel: In percent, as a loss against the mid-market rate.
routeData.breakdownHeading: Three steps make up the stablecoin's cost
routeData.breakdownLead: Pick a day to see each step next to the cheapest app.
routeData.breakdownFailed: The cost steps did not load. Reload to try again.
routeData.legsMissing: Steps without a bar were not recorded on {date}.
routeData.legsUnmeasured: A bank fee to pay in or take out was not measured on {date}. The real cost may be higher.
routeData.compareHeading: Every way of sending, compared at your amount
routeData.compareLead: Each row uses the amount chosen above.
routeData.whatHeading: Each line shows what matching the app takes
routeData.whatLead: Each figure is the usual cut needed at {amount} over the past week. The latest hour shows today's.
routeData.whatNeeded: less to buy and cash out stablecoins and match {app}, the cheapest app this week
routeData.whatShare: That is {pct} of what buying and cashing out costs now.
routeData.whatWins: {route} needs no cut to match the app
routeData.whatLatest: needed in the latest hour, {hour}, against {app}
routeData.whatLatestWins: The latest hour needs no cut
routeData.routeNotComparable: This route is not comparable yet. Against the mid-market rate its stablecoin cost comes out negative, which would make it look free.
routeData.notComparable: {routes} are left out. Against the mid-market rate their stablecoin cost comes out negative, which would make it look free, so it is not comparable yet.
routeData.whatPathNote: These cuts are measured against {path}, the cheapest stablecoin path in the latest hour. The steps above use {base}, so the two totals can differ.
routeData.whatAppChanged: The cheapest app changed during the week. {app} was cheapest in {hours} of {of} hours.
